1306.body:
## 用途与范围

这是用于检查拆分合入后差异的**草稿对照 PR，请勿合入**。原分支 `codex/local-capabilities-implementation` 到 `main` 已有开放的 #1148；GitHub 不允许对同一对分支重复开 PR，因此此 PR 的源分支是原分支当前提交的快照，不会自动跟随原分支更新。

- 原分支快照：`90edcbfd9fe0959bf98e5b85107670138ab477ea`
- 对照的 `main`：`b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64`
- 共同祖先：`9a013198dc054713e5692ceb8189f20971226d79`
- 拆分 PR：#1188、#1189、#1190、#1191，均已合入。

**阅读 Files changed 的注意事项：** GitHub 按共同祖先展示 PR 差异。由于四个拆分 PR 采用了不同的提交历史，那里仍会显示已经进入 `main` 的改动；不能把页面中的所有改动都当成遗漏，也不能把此对照 PR 当成合入方案。

## 当前文件核对

以原分支相对共同祖先变更的 117 个路径为范围，逐个比较两个固定提交的文件内容：

| 结果 | 数量 | 含义 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| 文件内容完全一致 | 83 | 包含日历读取、写入、定位、权限和多项测试的主要文件。 |
| 两侧内容不同 | 26 | 包括共享页面抽取、飞书及其他主干改动、测试增强和文档差异，需要结合实际行为核对。 |
| 原路径在 `main` 不存在 | 8 | 下述验收文档与证据均已归档，已逐文件验证压缩包内的内容与原分支逐字节一致。 |

文件一致性和文件数量不能证明运行行为完全一致；以下结论保留验证范围。

### 已核实的差异

1. **验收证据已归档。** 3 张历史日历截图原文件分别在 [inherited-calendar.zip](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64/tests/e2e/results/calendar-location-acceptance-20261112/inherited-calendar.zip) 和 `calendar-history.zip` 中；日历结果优化验收文档及 4 个原始证据文件在 [inherited-location.zip](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64/tests/e2e/results/calendar-location-acceptance-20261112/inherited-location.zip) 中。上述 8 个文件均逐字节比对通过。当前验收页面：[日历](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64/tests/e2e/results/calendar-location-acceptance-20261112/CALENDAR.md)、[定位](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64/tests/e2e/results/calendar-location-acceptance-20261112/LOCATION.md)。
2. **归档文档存在过时描述。** `main` 的 [设备权限文档](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64/docs/archive/client/digitalmate-device-permissions.md#L17-L18) 仍称本机日历直接读取且原始日历不发云端。实际代码将日历意图交给云端，设备处理 `device_calendar_read` 后通过 `task.calendar_read_result` 回传必要结果；应后续修正文档，不能将该文档作为当前路径的依据。
3. **实现结构有变化。** `main` 将本地能力连接页面的展示抽到 `LocalCapabilitiesView`，并在云适配器保留了主干飞书账户授权与日历/定位交互。聊天页还有主干的连接和附件处理变更；这些是需要按行为而非直接覆盖文件来审视的差异。
4. **测试名称核对。** 7 个存在差异的 Node/Python 测试文件中，原分支的测试名称均仍存在。原生位置脚本中两项检查点更名，当前脚本分别检查撤权后的日历读取与重新授权后的更新位置和城市；这只是静态核对，不代表本次重新运行了对应设备用例。

### 验证边界

本次只做固定提交的静态文件和归档内容核对，未重新执行设备或端云 E2E。历史验收记录对应各自记录的源码、测试包和参与方，不自动等同于当前 `main` 的完整端云验收。日历/定位原生验收页面保留了真实云端会话、签名包和部分故障注入尚未覆盖的边界。

1306.head: codex/compare-local-capabilities-main-20261113-audit
1306.title: [仅对比] 本地能力原分支与 main 差异核查

1307.author: niuypei
1307.body:
Refs #1258. Depends on #1298 (PR02), which depends on #1292 (PR01). Target: `main`; do not merge before prerequisite and owner/CI acceptance. The branch includes those prerequisites; the PR03 implementation is `0cb283c55602009c7f7e33b002547ebe1ac378c0`, followed by reconciliation with main `84aff23e` and `b67218b3`.

## Problem and behavior

PR02 restricts recovery to the current session and its direct predecessor, but a large tool result can exceed its record limit and more than 30 matches cannot be delivered completely. PR03 streams published raw records and actual writer-produced blobs, keeps bounded parser/matching state between calls, and preserves pending matches across result pages.

For example, a method at the tail of a 5 MiB tool result can now be recovered and used to query the current business result. The 31-hit fixture returns 30 then 1; replaying the same continuation returns the same page without rereading history bodies. `read_history_evidence` returns a limited original-text window under current permission. Source selection remains the current physical session followed by its same-scope direct predecessor, using existing permissions; no new historical provenance ledger or producer admission is introduced.

## Implementation and limits

- Strict incremental UTF-8/JSON parsing, chunk-boundary literal matching, late field/role/control filtering, published-chain verification, and safe streamed blob verification.
- Query-bound volatile cursors, pending-hit retention, bounded replay/evidence caches, and current permission/source validation on continuation and evidence delivery.
- Actual SDK tool registration and prompts, local runtime package 0.3.0, package/ownership/test enrollment, v3 architecture/scenario documents and template review deck. Main task-level MCP selection remains active with history authorization on send, steer and resume.
- Per call: 8 MiB I/O, 30 hits, 32 KiB result; each record/blob at most 64 MiB; at most 8192 indexed events per source. Explicit capacity/expiry/corruption responses do not claim complete no-match. Existing published-head metadata has no byte offset, so first chain proof still uses newline-aware one-byte reads. This change does not promise lower wall time on every input.
- Fixed views across different queries/Retry remain PR04; durable progress after process loss remains PR05; ordinary-tool process isolation remains PR06.

## Validation

Frozen runtime candidate: `0361a6e91e54acf07b6f0f8768e5f3f00a878eb4`; subsequent receipt changes are documentation only. [Full receipt](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/30f43bd522a6d04a2f955d5863436a8a171859d2/docs/verification/history-recovery-pr03-2026-11-13.md), [v3 design](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/30f43bd522a6d04a2f955d5863436a8a171859d2/docs/architecture/server-history-context-recovery-v3.md), [scenarios](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/30f43bd522a6d04a2f955d5863436a8a171859d2/docs/scenarios/server-history-context-recovery-v3.md).

- **540 distinct tests PASS, 1 inherited test FAIL**, no skips: affected batch 485 pass/1 fail (389 subtests pass); actual SDK 9 pass; architecture boundary, registry, upstream identity and snapshot suites 46 pass. Repeated runs and subtests are not added to the distinct count.
- The failure is `test_a_tool_token_gives_captures_only_within_its_task`: the exact main baseline and candidate both reject removed `capture.give` as `BAD_PARAMS`; cross-task forbidden assertions pass. Its source and assertions remain unchanged. Both failing runs are retained.
- Actual writer/SDK/tool combination recovers the 5 MiB tail method and obtains 117 from a controlled loopback API instead of the stored old 83. The 31-hit, cursor replay, revoked evidence and lifecycle cases also pass. Model, scope fixtures and business API are controlled substitutes; these are not live product/HAP results.
- Trusted-base architecture: 354 files, 109 checked, zero findings. Five locally built wheels were explicitly installed and 4454 payload files compared to declared source/build overlay and installed bytes; `pip check` passes.
- A separate actual-writer 5 MiB query observed 165786 bytes peak new traced Python allocations. Fixture/import initialization precedes measurement; this is not total process RSS, native allocation or concurrent-query worst case.

## Remaining acceptance

**Not merge-ready.** Trusted configured-source SDK adoption still rejects the changed SDK inputs/new recovery package; the trusted Bridge resource proof fails on both baseline and candidate. These are source/tooling acceptance obligations, not environment-only waivers. Full protected suite execution is blocked by its runner guard, and Docker has no daemon/socket here. Native CI, design/shared-owner acceptance and live deployed model/API/HAP verification retain their own pending results. No verifier was weakened and no skipped/unrun gate is counted as passed.
1307.head: feat/history-streaming-search
1307.title: feat(history): stream large records and paginate recovery evidence

1315.author: niuypei
1315.body:
Refs #1258. Depends on #1307 (PR03), then #1298 (PR02) and #1292 (PR01). Target: `main`; the branch contains those prerequisites. This PR's runtime changes are frozen at `03a2aa75bb98ab49839407ee835426ace352db1f`, atop PR03 `30f43bd522a6d04a2f955d5863436a8a171859d2` and main `b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64`.

## Problem and behavior

PR03 fixes the bounds of one search. A different keyword or Retry can still capture a later publication head or choose a different physical session. PR04 fixes the initial current/direct-predecessor candidates and their published heads before the first model call, persists that small view through the existing EngineStore, and reuses it across queries, Retry and restart.

For example, V1 captures S002/S001 through event 31. Appending event 32 containing `LATE_Q` does not make it visible to a new query or Retry. Explicit `refresh_history` creates V2 and reveals it. An old V1 cursor continues V1; replaying the same refresh returns the original V2 receipt. Rotating to S003 does not introduce S003 into this recovery, including on refresh. A new business request selects current/direct predecessor anew.

## Implementation and limits

- Current logical-session permission remains authoritative on preparation, every read and delivery. No new historical provenance ledger or producer admission is required.
- The existing Store atomically CAS-writes a bounded manifest and refresh receipts. Unknown outcomes are reconciled under the original operation; an uncommitted SQLite row cannot acknowledge success. At most 16 immutable views are retained per recovery; capacity is explicit, without silent eviction.
- Bridge and both SDK adapters await preparation before model execution. The refresh tool derives its identity from the actual SDK ToolCall and takes no model-supplied identifiers or paths. Old refresh replay cannot move the default view backwards.
- Recovery package 0.4.0, explicit ownership and test registration, architecture/scenario v4, ADR and template review deck accompany the change.
- A restarted search may rescan the original fixed range. Durable scan progress/pages/responses are PR05; ordinary-tool process isolation is PR06. A view does not retain deleted/replaced history or freeze authorization.

## Validation

Frozen runtime candidate: `03a2aa75bb98ab49839407ee835426ace352db1f`; subsequent receipt edits are documentation only. [Full verification receipt](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/016ff6d654b7ff88254193b68b50bb5827f79ac6/docs/verification/history-recovery-pr04-2026-11-13.md), [v4 design](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/016ff6d654b7ff88254193b68b50bb5827f79ac6/docs/architecture/server-history-context-recovery-v4.md), [scenario](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/016ff6d654b7ff88254193b68b50bb5827f79ac6/docs/scenarios/server-history-context-recovery-v4.md).

- **702 distinct tests PASS, 6 inherited tests FAIL**, no skips: affected batch 643 pass / 6 fail (443 subtests pass); actual SDK 13 pass; architecture boundary, registry, upstream identity and snapshot suites 46 pass. Repeated runs and subtests are not added to the distinct count.
- All six failures reproduce on exact PR03 parent `30f43bd5`: the removed `capture.give` operation, plus five existing EngineService expectations. Their assertions remain intact. The case-catalog check also reports seven pre-existing unregistered calendar/location markers.
- The actual SDK / Unix socket / source owner / SQLite Store / reader combination verifies before-model preparation, query changes, explicit refresh, old-cursor stability, Store reopen/session rotation and revocation. Model, transport and business API controls are explicit substitutes; these are not live product/HAP results.
- Store failure injection covers commit acknowledgment loss and simultaneous release/rollback failure, preventing uncommitted rows from becoming success receipts. Actual UDS tests exercise malformed/deep responses, cancellation and preserved actual I/O counts on failure.
- Trusted-base architecture: 356 files, 111 checked, zero findings. Five locally built wheels were explicitly installed; all 4456 payload files match declared source/build overlays and installed bytes. Both runtime overlays and `pip check` pass.

## Remaining acceptance

**Open for review; not merge-ready.** Trusted configured-source SDK adoption rejects the changed SDK inputs and does not include the recovery package; trusted Bridge resource proof fails on both baseline and candidate. These are source/tooling acceptance requirements. Full protected server execution remains blocked by the runner guard and absent Docker daemon/socket. Owner design/contract acceptance and live deployed model/API/HAP verification remain pending. No trusted verifier was weakened and no skipped/unrun gate is counted as passed.
1315.head: feat/history-fixed-recovery-view
1315.title: feat(history): preserve fixed recovery views across queries and retries

1319.author: niuypei
1319.body:
Refs #1258. Depends on #1315 (PR04), then #1307 → #1298 → #1292. Targets `main`; the branch includes these prerequisites. PR05 runtime source is frozen at `8e9979336c4a15543ab24a84cb06a030ca37d55b`, atop PR04 `016ff6d654b7ff88254193b68b50bb5827f79ac6` and main `b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64`.

## Problem and behavior

A fixed PR04 view still loses search progress when its process exits or a response is lost. Retrying then rereads the same history. PR05 saves each bounded page, parser/checksum checkpoint, finite evidence windows and batch association atomically through the existing EngineStore, then persists the completed response before delivery. A retry resumes uncommitted work and replays committed pages/results.

The actual WebSocket `task.run` → Bridge → Store → SDK → authority → reader test kills and restarts the process at three barriers. Before a page commit, retry reads 1,194 body bytes / 599 calls. After the page commit or response commit, retry search plus evidence reads **0 body bytes / 0 body-read calls** and the task completes with current API result 117. The exact PR04 parent control rereads 1,194 bytes / 599 calls. Model/session transport and loopback business API are controlled substitutes; this is not deployed HAP/live-provider acceptance.

## Implementation and boundaries

- Bridge owns durable search execution; SDK tools pass actual ToolCall identity and remaining enclosing budget privately. Cursors and evidence bind to the original immutable view and query plan.
- EngineStore remains the sole writer. Atomic records, explicit capacity, original-operation reconciliation, lease renewal and monotonic fencing prevent duplicate or stale worker commits. Current permission revisions are checked inside the writer transaction and immediately before response admission.
- Existing logical-session permissions and the fixed current/direct-predecessor candidates remain authoritative. No provenance ledger, producer admission, new database writer or raw-history migration is introduced.
- Recovery package 0.5.0, explicit Core/SDK source overrides, 19 registered feature modules, suite enrollment, [v5 design](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/827dc72739abc1f1b37e3e38f17f65a20178d6d1/docs/architecture/server-history-context-recovery-v5.md), scenarios, ADR and 14-slide review deck accompany the change.
- Pages are reused within their original plan, not across different queries/views/scopes. Capacity is bounded and explicit; automatic GC and ordinary-tool/process isolation are not added. PR06 retains isolation scope.

## Validation and tradeoff

[Full verification receipt](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/827dc72739abc1f1b37e3e38f17f65a20178d6d1/docs/verification/history-recovery-pr05-2026-11-13.md).

- **793 distinct tests PASS, 6 inherited tests FAIL, zero skips**: affected batch 730 pass / 6 fail (590 subtests pass); SDK 16 pass; process recovery 1 pass with 3 barriers; independent boundary/registry/upstream/snapshot suites 46 pass. Repeats and subtests are not added to the distinct count.
- State/retry tests cover lost commit/response acknowledgments, partial-batch restart, concurrent SQLite writers, lease takeover, slow I/O, cancellation, revoked/regranted permissions, response-delivery races, budget inheritance and checksummed but wrongly associated records.
- Trusted-base architecture scans 360 files / 115 checked modules with zero findings. Candidate upstream identities and all selected local documentation/deck structure checks pass; visual rendering is not run.

Five explicitly installed wheels: 4,460 payload files match source/declared overlays/installed bytes; both runtime overlays and `pip check` pass. Source integration and isolated installed-payload verification are separate checks.

Serializable SHA-256 state has a material first-scan cost: a fixed 5 MiB writer-blob comparison took **1.94 s without durability vs 9.65 s with checkpoint export/reconstruction per page (~5×)**, with identical bytes/read calls/hits. This improves interrupted-work reuse and does **not** establish overall latency improvement. The measurement and source hashes are retained; performance acceptance remains open.

## Remaining acceptance

**Open for review, not merge-ready.** Six unchanged regressions reproduce on the exact PR04 parent; case catalog retains seven existing unregistered calendar/location markers. Trusted configured-source SDK adoption rejects changed SDK/Core inputs and lacks the recovery package; the trusted Bridge resource proof fails on baseline and candidate. No verifier or assertion was weakened.

The protected full server suite, deployment/HAP/live-provider validation, statistical performance acceptance and owner acceptance of contracts/persisted format/lifecycle remain pending or unrun as recorded in the receipt. Native CI will be read back at this PR head; skipped checks are not passes. No merge or `pr-ready` label is requested by this change.
1319.head: feat/history-durable-search
1319.title: feat(history): resume durable search pages after retries

1321.author: Jianyu010
1321.body:
## Problem

`architecture-conformance` mixes two versions of the gate. The workflow file comes from main's tip (as with any `pull_request_target`), but the trusted scanner, policy and snapshot self-tests come from `github.event.pull_request.base.sha`, the PR's *recorded* base. That base can be hours or days old. Today this caused two separate waves of red PRs:

- **04:03:** `invalid architecture scan: No such file … module-ownership.json`. The workflow expected the path #1203 introduced, but the PR's base (69a2ebd0) still had the old path.
- **13:23, #1292:** the snapshot self-test failed with the AR10 that #1291 had already fixed, because the PR's recorded base (4fb8488b) predates #1291.

Each repair on main only reached a PR after its author merged main.

## Change

- The trusted side (scanner, policy, self-tests, gate-report merge script) now comes from `github.sha`, which is the current base tip under `pull_request_target`.
- The candidate is **the PR head merged into that tip**, so a PR that is behind main isn't asked for enforced sources it hasn't seen yet. The merge is built from raw objects with `git merge-tree --write-tree` and `commit-tree`: no checkout, hooks, attributes or merge drivers, with a fixed identity and date so the result is deterministic. It's recorded in `reports/candidate-merge.json`. A conflict fails with "merge main into it".
- History is deepened in bounded steps. The bounds are repository variables (`DM31_MERGE_FETCH_DEPTH`, `DM31_MERGE_DEEPEN_ROUNDS`), with defaults in the workflow.
- Manual dispatch, bootstrap and hosted-adoption paths are unchanged.
- The selection tests now expect the tip-based base, and I added merge tests: merge content, determinism, conflicts, and bounds validation. The gate guide documents the behaviour.

## Verification (local, macOS, Python 3.12, Git 2.54)

- `tests/ci/test_server_snapshots.py`: 29 tests pass, including the 3 new merge tests and the real-scanner legal export.
- `tests/server/test_hosted_store_bootstrap_mode.py` (17) and `test_hosted_consumer_adoption.py` (6) pass. `test_a01_bootstrap_mode.py` has one error, `old trusted policy must reject exactly the one Root Writer owner`, which fails identically on unmodified main.
- `tests/architecture`: 221 tests, 1 error from macOS `/tmp` → `/private/tmp` symlink resolution in `test_feishu_registration`. That code is untouched here, and the error is expected to be absent on the Linux runner.
- End to end: #1292's head merged into main `b67218b3` and scanned with main's scanner and policy gives exit 0 with no findings.

Like any change to `ci.yml`/`scripts/ci`, this PR's own run uses the old gate. The new behaviour applies from the first run after merge. The runner needs Git ≥ 2.38 for `merge-tree --write-tree`, and the job fails with that message if it's older.

1323.author: Jianyu010
1323.body:
## 背景

#1280 之后，main 的 `pyproject.toml` force-include 了四个 `temp/` 特性包（`dm_connection_foundation`、`dm_feishu_connector`、`signal_pipeline`、`mail_signals`），`.github/ci-gates.json` 也追加了这些特性的 `caseRoot` / `sourcePaths` / `enrolled` / `sourcePackages` 行。已安装包证明有两处受信 pin 仍只认旧内容，因此在 main 上失败：

1. Bridge wheel 的 force-include 映射只允许 `device-settings.json`（`test_contract_package` 在 main 上 1 error）。
2. `INCOMING_REGISTRY` 要求 `ci-gates.json` 与 pin 完全相等（`test_installed_package_proof` 的 `setUpClass` 报 "incoming registry must preserve every old row and append exactly both markers"）。

本 PR 修门禁本身，不改任何特性 PR。

## 改动

- **`482c0f1f` force-include 映射**：除原有 device-settings 行外，只接受 `"../../../../temp/<feature>/src/<package>" = "<package>"`。要求：特性经架构门禁自己的受信准入（`admitted_policy`，policy 取自 `/trusted` 基线，候选改自己的 policy 不生效）；该特性登记了 `<package>/__init__.py`；路径无符号链接；包名不与既有 owner 包、`server`、标准库冲突；安装文件逐字节比对。`tools/architecture/check.py` 的两步准入合并为 `admitted_policy`，扫描和证明共用。
- **`2dd0f987` incoming registry pin**：所有 pin 值及键顺序必须不变；只允许在上述四处追加 `temp/<feature>/` 下、形状固定的新行，每行须为真实目录、所属特性须被受信门禁准入、源包须归属该特性；新 suite 名不得复用 enrolled/deferred/future 名；重复键或行拒绝。与 pin 完全相同的 registry 照旧通过。
- `tests/architecture/test_feishu_registration.py`：temp 根目录 `resolve()`，修复 macOS `/private/var` 符号链接导致的本地失败。
- `tests/session_proximity/test_contracts.py`：仅调用处传入本 checkout 作为受信基线，未删断言。
- 文档：`ci-installed-package-proof.md`（Transition packages 一节）、`architecture-gate.md`、`temp/AGENTS.md`。

## 验证（本地，Python 3.12）

- `tests.server.test_installed_package_proof` 37/37（无 stub）
- `tests.server.test_contract_package` 69/69
- `tests.server.test_package_orchestrator` 18/18
- `tests/architecture` 221/221
- `tools/architecture/check.py`：0 findings，准入 3 个特性
- 每类拒绝路径（未准入特性、非 temp 路径、符号链接、重名、改/删旧行、复用 suite 名等）均有负向测试

NOT_RUN：受保护 Linux Docker 安装包证明（`/trusted` 挂载下的生产路径）；真实 hatchling 构建。特性包只做字节比对，安装探针不执行它们。

## 待定

- 本 PR 修改受信门禁代码，不能自我授权，需要独立的 policy 审阅。
- #1226 的 Beebou 仍会被拒：它没有 `temp/beebou/ownership.json`，其登记在 #1264 的受信 sidecar 中。需决定改为 #1280 式自登记，或把 sidecar 并入 `admitted_policy`。#1264 的 `check.py` 会与本 PR 冲突。

Refs #1228 #1280
